fields.description: Issue features reporting and commentary on alleged bankruptcy-related fraud involving lawyers and financial dealings connected to Miami Beach properties; city and county financial scandals and audits revealing shortages in municipal departments; and grand jury investigations tied to local politics. Includes a public-safety campaign page urging caution to prevent automobile and bicycle accidents, coverage of local sports (including boxing), and entertainment/society columns. Also reports results and ongoing promotion of a city-wide “Most Attractive Working Girl” beauty contest and contains numerous local advertisements.
